title: Workspace repository review with the native CLI
alt: The agentweaver workspace refs, tree, or file command opens one browser review for one read. The operator approves the repository and action at the Identity Broker. The CLI gets a single-use selection and sends it to the Gateway for one bounded read.

participants.label: Native CLI
participants.subLabel: agentweaver workspace refs, tree, or file

participants.label: Operator browser
participants.subLabel: Current Broker cookie and antiforgery token

participants.subLabel: Existing OAuth flow and private code ticket

participants.label: Gateway + Orchestrator
participants.subLabel: Typed Workspace reads and current owner checks

steps.label: The CLI reads the actor, tenant, connection, and repository name from the Gateway. It sends a version 2 Workspace intent.
Open existing authorization request with exact bounded Workspace intent
Review exact repo and operation with current cookie and antiforgery token
Create an owner-bound selection through the existing Repo App connection
Exact loopback GET callback carries OAuth code and state only
Exchange code over HTTPS with the S256 verifier
Return OAuth tokens and private workspace_selection response parameter
Selection is not part of the callback, OAuth tokens, logs, vault or evidence. Each repository read gets a new selection.
Read refs, tree, or file once with the required selection header
Return bounded data after current project and repository owner checks
Run B receipts, child startup, and terminal cleanup are separate flows; this check does not exercise them.
